result.stdout:
convoy — Convoy multi-tenant management CLI

Usage: convoy <command> [options]

Commands:
  status                          Fleet migration status
  migrate                         Run migrations across the fleet
  rollback --tenant ID --target M Rollback a tenant to a target migration
  pending  --tenant ID            Show pending migrations for a tenant
  validate                        Pre-flight validation (no migration)
  runs [--last N]                 List recent migration runs
  run  --id RUNID                 Show run detail
  resume --run RUNID              Resume an interrupted run
  tenant add --id ID --name NAME  Create a new tenant
  tenant activate --id ID         Activate a tenant
  tenant deactivate --id ID       Deactivate (suspend) a tenant
  tenant list                     List all tenants

Migrate options:
  --dry-run                       Simulate without touching databases
  --parallel N                    Max concurrent tenant migrations
  --tenants a,b,c                 Migrate specific tenants only
  --target MIGRATION              Pin to a specific migration name

Global options:
  --url URL                       Management API base URL  (default: http://localhost:5000)
  --key KEY                       API key for authentication

Configuration:
  Set CONVOY_URL and CONVOY_API_KEY env vars, or create ~/.convoy/config.json:
  { "Url": "https://yourapp.com", "ApiKey": "your-key" }

Usage: convoy <command> [options]

Commands:
  status                          Fleet migration status
  migrate                         Run migrations across the fleet
  rollback --tenant ID --target M Rollback a tenant to a target migration
  pending  --tenant ID            Show pending migrations for a tenant
  validate                        Pre-flight validation (no migration)
  runs [--last N]                 List recent migration runs
  run  --id RUNID                 Show run detail
  resume --run RUNID              Resume an interrupted run
  tenant add --id ID --name NAME  Create a new tenant
  tenant activate --id ID         Activate a tenant
  tenant deactivate --id ID       Deactivate (suspend) a tenant
  tenant list                     List all tenants

Migrate options:
  --dry-run                       Simulate without touching databases
  --parallel N                    Max concurrent tenant migrations
  --tenants a,b,c                 Migrate specific tenants only
  --target MIGRATION              Pin to a specific migration name

Global options:

  --key KEY                       API key for authentication
